tellings.link_reason: Both are Lazar's firsthand account of the S-4 emitter making a little black ball where no light escaped.

as_told.title: Lazar's reactor emitter creates a little black ball

plain: At a secret Nevada site called S4, sometime between 1987 and 1989, a device Bob Lazar calls an emitter is said to have made "a little black ball in the air where no light was escaping, looking like a little black hole." Lazar, who says he worked on alien craft there, tells it firsthand and names a coworker, Barry Castilio, as part of the scene. In one telling he adds that the emitter was rotated to make the ball, which would mean the device could bend space or light.
